quote.text: "So the Kingdom still has an army?"

quote.speaker: Unknown
quote.text: "Not an army. A village that refuses to stop fighting. It's not the same thing, but Eggman keeps losing to it anyway."

parts.text:
The Freedom Fighters are one of the oldest organized resistance groups in the world, predating the Restoration and many of the resistance movements that would later emerge across the globe.

Originally formed to reclaim the Acorn Kingdom from Dr. Eggman, the Freedom Fighters have evolved from a small group of young rebels into a highly experienced resistance organization. Their purpose, however, has remained largely unchanged: **fight against those who seek to take away people's freedom (specially Eggman).**

Unlike the Restoration, whose primary focus is rebuilding communities and creating a better future, the Freedom Fighters specialize in stopping the threats that continue to endanger the present. They are soldiers, tacticians, spies, scouts, and rebels who operate on the front lines as well as behind enemy lines.

They defend towns, liberate occupied territories, sabotage enemy infrastructure, gather intelligence, train new recruits, and support resistance movements beyond their own borders.

The two organizations frequently cooperate, sharing resources, intelligence, and personnel when necessary. Where the Restoration builds, the Freedom Fighters fight to make sure there is something worth rebuilding.

Their ultimate goal is not simply to win another battle against Eggman.

It is to make sure he can never threaten their people again.
parts.caption: Sonic Universe Nº95 Variant

parts.title: Past
parts.text:
Long before the Restoration existed, and before organized resistance movements became common across the world, there was the first spark of rebellion: the Freedom Fighters.

After the fall of the Acorn Kingdom, Princess Sally Acorn was only a small child when she began gathering others who refused to accept Eggman's rule. What started as a handful of young heroes determined to reclaim their homeland slowly developed into a genuine resistance movement.

They had almost none of the advantages Eggman's forces possessed. They lacked numbers, resources, equipment, and formal military training. What they did have was determination, knowledge of their homeland, and the willingness to fight an enemy who believed they had already won.

The Freedom Fighters relied heavily on sabotage, infiltration, espionage, reconnaissance, and carefully planned strikes. They avoided fighting Eggman's forces on their terms whenever possible, instead attacking supply lines, disrupting operations, freeing prisoners, sabotaging factories, and striking vulnerable targets before disappearing again.

Over time, their successes accumulated.

The small rebellion became a force that Eggman's Empire could no longer ignore. And, eventually, the Freedom Fighters succeeded in their greatest objective: the Acorn Kingdom was liberated.

Eggman's forces were driven out, the people were able to return to their homes, and the kingdom began the long process of recovering from years of occupation.

For the first time, the Freedom Fighters had won.

But their work was far from over.
parts.caption: Freedom fighters Archie

parts.title: Post-Liberation / Pre-Forces
parts.text:
Liberating the Acorn Kingdom did not erase the damage Eggman had left behind.

Years of occupation had changed the kingdom permanently. Factories, military installations, damaged infrastructure, polluted areas, abandoned weapons, and remnants of Eggman's forces remained scattered throughout the country. Entire communities had to learn how to live without the Empire's presence.

The Freedom Fighters refused to simply walk away so their role changed from liberators to protectors.

They helped towns defend themselves against remaining threats, dismantled abandoned military installations, destroyed dangerous technology, hunted down remnants of Eggman's forces, and assisted communities in reclaiming areas that had once been under Imperial control.

But their efforts eventually extended beyond the Acorn Kingdom.

The Freedom Fighters understood better than most what it meant to lose a homeland. As other regions began suffering under Eggman's expansion, they started assisting local resistance groups and emerging rebel movements.

They shared intelligence, provided training, supplied equipment, and occasionally sent their own members to fight alongside foreign resistance forces.

Their reputation spread.

The Freedom Fighters became more than the resistance of one kingdom. They became an example of what could be accomplished against an enemy that appeared impossible to defeat.
parts.caption: Freedom Fighters - Art by herms85 in DeviantArt

parts.title: War of Forces
parts.text:
When the War of Forces began, Eggman's Empire struck the Acorn Kingdom once again.

The kingdom that the Freedom Fighters had spent years protecting was reclaimed by the Empire, turning their homeland back into a battlefield.

For the Freedom Fighters, this was more than another military conflict. It was a devastating reminder that their previous victory had never been permanent. But neither were they the same people who had fought the first occupation.

Years of experience had transformed the Freedom Fighters into a highly capable resistance force. They knew Eggman's tactics. They knew the terrain. They understood how his armies operated, where his supply lines were vulnerable, and how to fight a superior force without confronting it directly.

They returned to the methods that had made them legends.

Sabotage.

Infiltration.

Intelligence.

Guerrilla warfare.

Open combat when necessary.

Little by little, the Freedom Fighters began reclaiming the Acorn Kingdom.

Their progress was slow, costly, and often difficult, but they managed to take back roughly half of the kingdom and their capital.

The war had once again proven what the Freedom Fighters had always believed:

**Being outnumbered does not mean being defeated.**
parts.caption: Sonic Universe 96

parts.title: Post-Forces
parts.text:
Even after reclaiming large portions of their homeland, the Freedom Fighters understand that victory is not the same as restoration.

Eggman's second occupation has left another generation of scars across the Acorn Kingdom. Infrastructure has been damaged again, communities have been displaced, enemy technology remains scattered throughout the territory, and occupied areas still require liberation.

The Freedom Fighters therefore continue operating even after major battles have ended. Their mission is now twofold: **protect what has been reclaimed and continue pushing Eggman's  Northamer Army out of what remains occupied.**

They conduct raids against Imperial installations, disrupt supply routes, gather intelligence, protect liberated communities, and train the next generation of resistance fighters.

At the same time, they continue assisting resistance movements elsewhere in the world.

groups.title: Team Sally
groups.description: The main attack force of the Freedom fighters.

characters.name: Sally Acorn
characters.description: Princess of the Acorn Kingdom and the one who holds the movement together.

characters.name: Nicole the Holo-Lynx
characters.description: A highly intelligent, fiercely loyal holographic lynx AI and Sally Acorn’s trusted companion.

characters.name: Rotor the Walrus
characters.description: A brilliant, gentle-hearted inventor and steadfast freedom fighter who keeps the team’s machines running.

characters.name: Antoine D'Coolette
characters.description: A brave but bumbling French-accented freedom fighter who grows from a cowardly nobleman into a courageous swordsman.

characters.name: Bunnie D'Coolette
characters.description: A kind-hearted and resilient Southern belle cyborg who combines mechanical strength with warmth and compassion, always willing to stand up for her friends and those in need.

groups.title: Secret Freedom Fighters
groups.description: A covert resistance network dedicated to opposing tyranny from the shadows, relying on espionage, sabotage, and carefully coordinated missions to protect without drawing attention.

characters.name: Elias Acorn
characters.description: A thoughtful and compassionate leader who carries the weight of his kingdom's legacy, striving to protect his people and preserve their freedom through diplomacy and courage.

characters.name: Harvey Who
characters.description: A skilled and resourceful old member of the Acorn Kingdom's defense forces who uses his expertise and determination to support the resistance against tyranny, often operating alongside other covert members of the movement.

characters.name: Shard the Metal Sonic
characters.description: A reformed Metal Sonic prototype who overcame his original programming, becoming a loyal hero determined to protect others and prove that he can choose his own path.

characters.name: Larry the Lynx
characters.description: A young and determined freedom fighter who uses his courage and resourcefulness to stand against oppression and protect his people. He is known for his bad luck.

characters.name: Mina Mongoose
characters.description: A talented singer and former Freedom Fighter whose music inspires others, balancing her artistic career with a strong sense of courage, compassion, and loyalty.

characters.name: Julie-Su
characters.description: A tough and determined echidna with a sharp mind and fierce loyalty, who brings combat experience, independence, and a strong sense of justice to those she fights alongside. Formely a member of the Dark Brotherhood.

characters.name: Saffron Bee
characters.description: A gentle and compassionate bee who brings warmth and kindness to those around her, determined to help others and stand up for what is right.

characters.name: Uncle Chuck
characters.description: A wise and compassionate inventor who has endured years of hardship while remaining devoted to helping others and fighting for a better future.

characters.name: Ben Muttski
characters.description: A loyal and dependable Freedom Fighter who uses his courage and practical skills to support his allies and stand against those who threaten his home.
